get.description: Returns the company's onboarding status and the banner case the Capital Planning UI shows for it.

banner_case.description: 1: ready with Capital Planning projects; 2: syncing or failed; 3: no active Procore projects

banner_dismissed.description: True when banner_case is 1 (the company has projects in Capital Planning) and the calling user has dismissed the banner

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Procore-Company-Id': "SOME_STRING_VALUE" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/capital_planning/onboarding", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

post.description: Records that the calling user dismissed the onboarding banner. Only case 1 can be dismissed.

409.description: BANNER_NOT_DISMISSIBLE — the company is not in case 1

post.summary: Dismiss the Capital Planning onboarding banner
